All data is synthetic, hand-written from documented shapes; checked 2026-11-04. IDs, names, models and amounts are examples. No production responses or credentials.

- Anthropic: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-api and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/organization/api_keys/list
- OpenAI: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/admin-apis and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/spend-limits
- OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/analytics/query-analytics-data and https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/api-keys/list-api-keys
- Frankfurter v2: https://frankfurter.dev/

Error fixtures model status-specific shapes. Retry-After is supplied as an HTTP header by the fake fetch. OpenRouter truncated responses must be split before committing a snapshot.
